stage1.manifest_preprocessing: front camera 1920x1080, crop 28 top/bottom, resize 128x128, RGB uint8
stage1.manifest_selection_caveat: Complete 12-frame RGB availability required for video post-training; projected overlap is an occlusion proxy only
stage1.input_cache: Prepared 128-square uint8 RGB pixel frames, not cached particle features
stage1.training_logic: Official LPWM full-sequence DLP.forward + calc_dyn_elbo; all four modules trainable. No trajectory planner or online candidate oracle in the training loop.

current_joint_training.model_graph: Four sequential camera encodes; causal eight-step context/dynamics sample per camera; activation checkpoint recomputation during backward; official DrivoR candidate generation/scoring and CPU online oracle.

comparability_note: Different input and objective workloads; rates are historical observations on a shared machine, not a matched profiling experiment. Stage1 clip count is not the complete current trainval scene count.
